title: Demand paging fundamentals
objectives: Describe demand paging as a strategy where pages are loaded into memory only when referenced
Explain the benefit of demand paging over loading the entire program at once

blocks.text: With demand paging, the operating system initially loads only the essential pages of a process. When a program references a page not currently in memory, a page fault occurs, the OS loads the required page from disk, and execution resumes. This approach reduces initial load time and memory usage, as unused code and data never reside in physical memory.
